D/ SALUTIS ; R/ [MN] ACILIV[S] III VIR VALETV

A silver denarius of the Roman Republican period (BC49). Obverse description: Laureate head of Salus right. Obverse inscription: SALUTIS. Reverse description: Valetudo standing left,leaning gainst a column and holding a serpent. Reverse inscription: [MN] ACILIV[S] III VIR VALETV. minted in Rome by Man. Acilius Glabrio c.BC49 (Seaby 1978,p.10: no.8). Thickness: 2.1 mm. Weight: 3.5 g. Diameter: 17.42 mm. Ref: Seaby, H.A., 1978. Roman Silver Coins: I. Republic to Augustus, 3rd ed. B.A. Seaby, London
